title: Host-grid editing and clipboard logic exists in three diverging copies (Form1, JobEditorDialog, HostGridUtilities) — Form1 got the fast paste, the Job Editor kept the slow one
existing_state: The host grid UX is implemented twice-to-three-times in parallel. Form1 has private AddColumn/RenameColumn/DeleteColumn (Form1.cs:9380-9488), CopyToClipboard (:9545-9602, a line-for-line inline duplicate of HostGridUtilities.BuildClipboardText), PasteFromClipboard (:9604-9755), and IsProtectedColumn (:4050-4058). JobEditorDialog re-implements AddHostColumn/RenameHostColumn/DeleteHostColumn (JobEditorDialog.cs:956-1033) as near line-for-line clones of Form1's versions (including the same Microsoft.VisualBasic InputBox prompts), and delegates clipboard/column-name logic to HostGridUtilities (BuildClipboardText :147-221, PasteClipboardText :224-273, GetNextGeneratedColumnName :286-299). The copies have already diverged in four verified ways: (1) Form1.PasteFromClipboard is a heavily optimized rewrite — WM_SETREDRAW repaint suspension (9633-9637), AutoSizeColumnsMode parking with a comment calling out the O(rows^2) behavior (9643-9648), CellValueChanged handler detach (9650-9653), bulk off-grid Rows.AddRange (9716-9736) — while HostGridUtilities.PasteClipboardText is still the naive per-cell Rows.Add version (246-249) and is exactly what JobEditorDialog runs on Ctrl+V (JobEditorDialog.cs:1830-1839), so pasting a large host list from Excel freezes the Job Editor; (2) row-split semantics differ — Form1 splits on "\r\n" only (9612), the utility on '\n' with RemoveEmptyEntries (234-236); (3) Form1.AddColumn generates unique names case-sensitively (9383-9389) while GetNextGeneratedColumnName compares case-insensitively (286-299), and Form1's inline paste column auto-create (9666-9670) lacks the duplicate-name guard; (4) Form1.IsProtectedColumn additionally protects SelectColumnName, which HostGridUtilities knows nothing about. Tests cover only the utility (HostGridUtilitiesTests), so the code paths the main grid actually runs are the untested copies.
recommendation: Consolidate on HostGridUtilities as the single implementation: lift Form1's optimized paste into it (pre-parse, WM_SETREDRAW suspend, auto-size parking, bulk AddRange) with optional hooks for Form1-specific side effects (handler detach, Host_IP connection-state clearing) and a parameterized protected-column predicate; move Form1's column add/rename/delete and copy in as well; then have both Form1 and JobEditorDialog call the shared versions and delete the private copies. The existing HostGridUtilitiesTests/JobEditorDialogHostGridParityTests harness then covers the real production path, and the Job Editor inherits the fast paste for free.
user_benefit: Pasting a large host list into the Job Editor stops freezing the UI, and main-grid vs job-grid editing stop drifting apart — performance fixes, validation rules, and protected-column behavior apply everywhere at once instead of silently differing between the main window and the scheduler editor.
